title: Holographic generative flows with AdS/CFT
abstract: arXiv:2601.22033v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Holography, in the form of the anti-de Sitter/conformal field theory (AdS/CFT) correspondence, offers a natural setting for generative modelling. Data on a boundary manifold lifts into a higher-dimensional bulk through a propagator, and this extra dimension plays the role of a flow parameter. We exploit this structure to build GenAdS, an approach to generative flow matching in which the dynamics are represented by the evolution of fields in AdS, together with a residual correction learned by a neural network. Boundary samples are encoded as scalar sources, transported into the bulk along the flow, and decoded after numerical integration. Our paradigm combines a Fourier-space encoding scheme for the data as AdS sources, a normalised radial phase space in which to stage the flow-matching dynamics, and a Klein--Gordon backbone to guide the flow. translated_title: 基于 AdS/CFT 的全息生成流
translated_abstract: 全息学，以反德西特/共形场论（AdS/CFT）对应的形式，为生成建模提供了一个自然的框架。边界流形上的数据通过一个传播子被提升到更高维的体时空（bulk）中，而这个额外的维度扮演着流参数的角色。我们利用这一结构构建了 GenAdS，这是一种生成式流匹配方法，其动力学由 AdS 中场的演化来表示，并由神经网络学习一个残差修正。边界样本被编码为标量源，沿着流被输运到体时空中，并在数值积分之后被解码。我们的范式结合了以下要素：将数据作为 AdS 源的傅里叶空间编码方案、用于承载流匹配动力学的归一化径向相空间，以及引导流的克莱因-戈登（Klein–Gordon）主干网络。在二维棋盘格基准测试上，我们的实验表明，大部分收益来自……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出 GenAdS，一种基于 AdS/CFT 全息对应的生成式流匹配新方法，将边界数据编码为 AdS 标量源，通过克莱因-戈登场演化主干加神经网络残差修正来学习生成流。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes GenAdS, a novel generative flow matching approach based on the AdS/CFT holographic correspondence, which encodes boundary data as AdS scalar sources and learns generative flows via a Klein-Gordon field evolution backbone with a neural-network residual correction.
